name: buddysaradhi-reasoningbank
description: Isolated ReasoningBank vector store for agent trajectory learning. Deliberately OUTSIDE the pnpm workspace.
//: ISOLATION CONTRACT — read before adding a dependency here.
This package is NOT a member of the pnpm workspace (pnpm-workspace.yaml lists only
apps/*, apps/services/*, apps/gateway, packages/*). That is deliberate: it keeps
this tree out of the root lockfile, out of apps/* dependency resolution, and out of
every product bundle. See .planning/ROADMAP.md and worklog.md entry REASONINGBANK-01.
Constraints inherited from AGENTS.md:
Rule 2 — no network calls that process user data. Embeddings run LOCALLY via
@xenova/transformers. No query text is sent to any provider.
Rule 3 — no telemetry/analytics SDK. Nothing here phones home.
Rule 11 — one directory, one deployment target. Nothing here is deployed.
WHY agentdb IS PINNED EXACTLY TO 1.6.1:
agentic-flow@2.1.4 declares agentdb as an EXACT pin on 3.0.0-alpha.20 (no caret,
no range). Installing agentic-flow therefore forces the alpha, and its tree drags
in express, gun, axios, http-proxy-middleware, @supabase/supabase-js,
@anthropic-ai/sdk and @google/genai — two HTTP servers, an HTTP proxy and three
external AI-API clients. That is the exact shape AGENTS.md Rule 2 and Rule 3
forbid, in a repo that carefully scopes Supabase credentials.
Overriding agentdb back to 1.6.1 under agentic-flow would be a TWO-MAJOR jump
across an alpha API. A forced override across a major gap is the class of change
that appears to work and fails silently later, so it was rejected.
WHAT THIS WINS: agentdb@1.6.1 ships ReasoningBank NATIVELY, so nothing from
agentic-flow was needed. Verified exports include ReasoningBank, HNSWIndex,
WASMVectorSearch, EmbeddingService, ContextSynthesizer, MMRDiversityRanker,
ExplainableRecall, ReflexionMemory, SkillLibrary, LearningSystem and CausalRecall
— trajectory storage, verdict retrieval, context synthesis, diversity ranking
and memory optimisation all exist here. Verified 7/7 by scripts/smoke.mjs.
NOTE the API shape differs from the one the ReasoningBank skill documents.
The skill describes the agentic-flow adapter (createAgentDBAdapter,
pattern_data, type/domain, retrieveWithReasoning). agentdb's own controller is
flatter: constructor(db, embedder) where embedder exposes .embed(text),
storePattern({ taskType, approach, successRate, uses, avgReward, tags, metadata })
and searchPatterns({ taskEmbedding, k, threshold, filters }). storePattern embeds
`${taskType}: ${approach}` itself. scripts/smoke.mjs was written against the real
source rather than the skill's documented shape, which does not match it.
